_comment: NJAC Vision. Only entries in 'videos' are rendered. 'id' is the YouTube video id - the part after youtube.com/watch?v= , /live/ or /embed/ . Optional 'thumb' picks the preview image: omit it for the uploader's matchup graphic, use 'hq1' / 'hq2' / 'hq3' for YouTube's auto-captured frame from 25% / 50% / 75% into the stream, or give a full image URL for your own screenshot. Order here is the order shown on the page.
